nodes.label: angelOS CI checks job
nodes.rationale: Runs on pushes and PRs touching shell, configs, installer, scripts or packages. noto-fonts is installed because a real install has a Cyrillic fallback and the bundled Jacquard font is Latin only. diffutils is installed because the installer and update tests need diff/cmp. qt6-multimedia is installed because the harp menu and angel voice import QtMultimedia. The job mirrors scripts/ci-local.sh so it can be run locally before pushing.
